## Dinah

Some of your work is coordinated on Dinah workbenches. Where a project carries one, run `dinah status` to see which workbench answers from where you stand, and `dinah prime` at the start of every session to learn who you are acting as, what you hold, and what is ready for you.

Read `dinah guide first-session` before your first act on a workbench, and `dinah guide mcp` before you use the `dinah` MCP tools. The working agreement reaches you when the `dinah` MCP server connects, and it binds you rather than the tool.

You act as `helper`. Never act under the operator's name.
<!-- dinah-setup:end claude-code/instructions-user -->
